paragraphs.text: Razineth is a kor professor of Silverquill College on Arcavios .

Razineth is described as having a pale complexion typical of the kor , a humanoid race with distinctively white skin. He possesses a magical arm made of shadow-ink, enhancing his menacing and enigmatic presence. His voice is harsh and serpentine, adding to his intimidating aura. Razineth is aggressive and shows no mercy during duels, indicating a ruthless nature. His sarcasm suggests a disdainful and mocking attitude. He demonstrates powerful abilities in manipulating voiceless consonants to create lethal attacks, showing his mastery and confidence in his skills. Razineth remains unphased by Killian's efforts, maintaining a stoic and critical attitude throughout the duel.

Razineth, the esteemed proctor of the Intention & Subtext II course, conducted a lesson that unexpectedly turned into a fierce duel with his students. Despite the students' initial belief that this would be a simple exercise, Razineth attacked them relentlessly, breaking through their defenses with ease. He mocked Killian Lu 's efforts sarcastically and used his shadow-ink arm to create powerful spells with simple voiceless consonants, demonstrating his advanced skill and dominance. Even when Killian launched a well-coordinated assault, Razineth quickly countered with a defensive ink shield and followed up with devastating attacks, including a precise ink arrow that incapacitated Killian. Throughout the duel, Razineth's demeanor remained hard and unimpressed, showcasing his ruthless and formidable nature.
